evidence.detail: GET /llms.txt → HTTP 404; GET /llms-full.txt → HTTP 404; homepage has no llms.txt link
JSON-LD blocks ×2; contains key schema.org type; JSON-LD parsable
semantic landmarks 4/4; no h1; html[lang] present; body text 339 words

title "index"; missing/too-short meta description; date signal present; body text 339 words (moderate)
no public-API evidence; no API documentation entry point; OpenAPI not found
no in-site chat/assistant; no AI search; no developer console
